comparison.objective: Rotate and reclamp an angle-grinder guard toward the operator.
comparison.physical_skill: Lever release, guarded rotation, tool stabilization, and reclamping.
comparison.success_condition: Guard orientation and lever closure meet angular limits while the grinder remains stable and hands avoid the disc.
comparison.reason: This is angular adjustment of an attached guard, not staged installation of a long load-bearing rail across two supports.
